propositions: Cross-loaded Mutation instances (loaded under multiple sys.modules keys) caused isinstance checks to fail, routing supported mutations to batch path fallback with AttributeError.
Generic whole-operation retry, _best_effort write swallowing, class-name string dispatch, and duplicate SDK/adapter retry owners must be unreachable from production code.
Every supported Cloud/DC mutation route must have exactly one typed coordinator/adapter owner; unsupported actions must fail with a typed provider-neutral error before any effect.
Dispatch mechanism must use runtime_checkable declared protocol (MutationShape) rather than class identity checks to remain robust across module reloading and maintain identity-agnostic routing.
Tests must use explicit declared protocols rather than relying on production fallback paths; poison tests must verify removed helpers remain unreachable.
Rollback must be implemented via code/routing reversion and remote re-observation, never by compensating deletion of successful remote work.
